npcs.name: Hannibal Traven
npcs.greet: The University is open to anyone with patience and a mind. The first is rarer than you would think.

npcs.name: Raminus Polus
npcs.greet: Master of Initiates. Which means I read your recommendation letters, and I find out which of them were exaggerated.

npcs.name: Teekeeus
npcs.greet: Chorrol's chapter keeps a fine library, if one ignores the scorch marks. Mind the shelves. They bite. Well. One of them does.

relics.name: Teekeeus's Concordance
relics.desc: A fat, much-annotated index of the Chorrol library. Faintly singed, and missing a corner the scamp chewed off.

relics.name: Vahtacen Welkynd Stone
relics.desc: A blue crystal cut by Ayleid hands. It hums against the palm with stored light.

relics.name: Orders of the Black Worm
relics.desc: Names of Guild mages, their routes and their habits, in a careful cramped hand. Signed with a worm devouring its own tail.

relics.name: Black Soul Gem
relics.desc: A soul gem gone dark as a starless night. It can hold a mortal soul, and it wants to.

mg_worm_council: When I banned necromancy in the Guild, I knew some would leave. I did not expect them to come back hunting us.
These are not hedge-wizards. They answer to the King of Worms. Mannimarco.
Then we know who we are fighting. Find out what they are preparing. I want to see it before it sees us.
mg_necromancers_moon: Under the moon, the necromancers' altar shudders. A ray of grey light falls on the soul gem in its cradle, and the gem drinks it until it is black.
Somewhere far off, in a voice like dry leaves, someone laughs.
mg_king_of_worms: Traven sends a student? I was ancient when his tower was a field of mud. Every soul in this cave is mine. So is yours, now.
Kneel, and you may serve as you rot. Stand, and you will serve all the same.
mg_archmage: Mannimarco is dust. Do you understand what that means? Generations of mages will never know his name, because of you.
I am old, and this fight has taken more of me than I like to admit. The Council agrees: the University needs younger hands.
Arch-Mage. I suppose I'll have to stop correcting your spelling.

quests.title: A Matter of Recommendation
quests.offer: I'd like to join the Mages Guild.
quests.pitch: The University only admits those a chapter will vouch for. I will vouch for you, once you help me. An apprentice's summoning went astray and there are scamps loose in the stacks, eating my books. Get rid of them and find my Concordance before they finish it.
quests.desc: Teekeeus, head of the Mages Guild chapter in Chorrol, will recommend me to the Arcane University if I deal with the scamps loose in his library and recover his Concordance.

objectives.text: Banish the scamps loose in the Chorrol guild hall
objectives.journal: Three scamps, a great deal of smoke, and one very unhappy apprentice. The library will need a new rug.

objectives.text: Find Teekeeus's Concordance
Return the Concordance to Teekeeus
objectives.topic: The scamps are gone. Here is your Concordance, mostly.
objectives.reply: Mostly is more than I hoped for. Welcome to the Guild. My letter will be at the Arcane University before you are. Ask for Raminus Polus, and try not to set anything on fire.

quests.outro: I joined the Mages Guild in Chorrol. Teekeeus has written to the Arcane University on my behalf.

quests.title: The Arcane University
quests.desc: With a chapter's recommendation in hand, I can present myself at the Arcane University in the Imperial City and ask to be admitted as an apprentice.

objectives.text: Travel to the Arcane University in the Imperial City
Present yourself to Raminus Polus
objectives.topic: Teekeeus of Chorrol sent a recommendation for me.
objectives.reply: He did, in four pages, with diagrams. Before I admit you, tell me what you want from the University. People who don't know tend not to last.

objectives.text: Tell Raminus Polus what you seek at the University

choices.label: Knowledge. Everything the old masters wrote down.
choices.reply: A reader. Good. The Mystic Archives will eat your evenings. Don't let them eat your sleep.

choices.label: Power. Enough that nothing can threaten me.
choices.reply: Honest, at least. Most who say that end up in a necromancer's cellar or a Guild report. Learn restraint along with the spells.

choices.label: To protect people. Magic is a tool like any other.
choices.reply: Traven will like you. Try not to let him lecture you about it for more than an hour.

objectives.text: Meet the Arch-Mage, Hannibal Traven
objectives.reply: Then welcome. The University is the heart of the Guild, and the Guild is the conscience of Tamriel's magic, or it tries to be. Raminus will keep you busy.

quests.outro: I was admitted to the Arcane University as an apprentice. Raminus Polus warned me that the work would start immediately. He was not exaggerating.

quests.title: The Light of Vahtacen
quests.offer: Do you have work for an apprentice?
quests.pitch: The Ayleid ruin of Vahtacen, west of the lake, has a chamber our scholars could never open. A colleague swears it holds a working Welkynd stone. Bring one back intact and I will see you advanced. And watch for the dead. Ayleids rarely sleep alone.
quests.desc: Raminus Polus sent me to Vahtacen, an Ayleid ruin near Lake Rumare, to recover a Welkynd stone from a sealed chamber.

objectives.text: Travel to the Ayleid ruin of Vahtacen
Destroy the guardians of Vahtacen
Take the Welkynd stone from the sealed chamber
objectives.journal: The sealed chamber was open when I reached it. Someone had come before me, cut a black worm into the wall, and left the stone where it lay.

objectives.text: Bring the Welkynd stone to Raminus Polus
objectives.topic: The stone, intact. But someone had opened the chamber before me.
objectives.reply: A black worm carved on the wall? I was afraid of that. The stone is yours to keep for your trouble. The mark you saw is mine to worry about. For now.

quests.outro: I brought a Welkynd stone back from Vahtacen, but the Order of the Black Worm had been there first. Raminus did not look surprised.

quests.title: Shadows of the Worm
quests.desc: Guild mages travelling between chapters have been disappearing on the roads. Teekeeus's own journeyman has not reached Chorrol, and the University suspects the Order of the Black Worm.

objectives.text: Speak with Teekeeus in Chorrol
objectives.topic: The University says your journeyman never arrived.
objectives.reply: Three days late. She was carrying letters for the Arch-Mage. The road east of town runs past an old shepherd's track. Look there, and be ready for company.

objectives.text: Break the necromancers' ambush on the Chorrol road
objectives.journal: The journeyman was beyond help. The acolytes had been waiting for the next Guild mage to come along the same road.

objectives.text: Search the acolytes for their orders
Bring the orders to Hannibal Traven
objectives.topic: The necromancers have a list of Guild mages. Your name is on it.
objectives.reply: So is yours, I see. Stay a moment. Raminus should hear this.

quests.outro: The Order of the Black Worm is hunting the Mages Guild, and it answers to Mannimarco, the King of Worms. Traven means to strike first.

quests.title: Necromancer's Moon
quests.pitch: Black soul gems. On certain nights the necromancers' altars catch the moonlight and turn an ordinary gem into a vessel for a mortal soul. They make them at Fort Linchal, near Bravil. Go when the moon is up, scatter them, and bring me one of those gems.
quests.desc: Hannibal Traven believes the Order of the Black Worm makes black soul gems at an altar in Fort Linchal, near Bravil. He wants me to break the ritual on a moonlit night and bring him one of the gems.

objectives.text: Travel to Fort Linchal
Wait for nightfall at Fort Linchal
Break up the necromancers' ritual
Take the black soul gem from the altar
Bring the black soul gem to Hannibal Traven
objectives.topic: The ritual is broken. I have one of their gems.
objectives.reply: Let me see. Yes. I could fill this, you know. With my own soul, poured into a spell no necromancer could withstand. Or we break it here, and fight him as the Guild has always fought. Your counsel?

objectives.text: Advise Traven on the black soul gem

choices.label: Break it. We won't become what we're fighting.
choices.reply: Spoken like a true member of this Guild. There. Gone. We'll find another way to his door.

choices.label: Keep it, but only as a last resort.
choices.reply: A last resort it is. I'll lock it in my study and pray I never need it.

quests.outro: I broke the Black Worm's ritual at Fort Linchal and brought back one of their black soul gems. Among the necromancers' papers was the name of the place where their master waits: Echo Cave.

quests.title: The King of Worms
quests.desc: Mannimarco, the King of Worms, waits in Echo Cave, east of the Imperial City. Traven has charged me with ending him before his Order can strike the University itself.

objectives.text: Travel to Echo Cave
Fight through the Order of the Black Worm
Destroy Mannimarco, King of Worms
objectives.journal: Mannimarco was older than anything I had fought, and the dead rose for him without being asked. He came apart at last into dust and the smell of old paper.

objectives.text: Report to Hannibal Traven at the Arcane University
objectives.reply: Then sit. No, sit, before you fall down. There is something the Council and I must say to you.

quests.outro: I destroyed Mannimarco, the King of Worms, in Echo Cave. Hannibal Traven stepped aside and the Council of Mages named me his successor.
